company_description: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited is a Canadian mining company specializing in the exploration, development, and operation of gold mines. It operates primarily in North America, Europe, and Australia, with a diversified portfolio of producing mines, development projects, and exploration sites. The company emphasizes sustainability, responsible governance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: Total gold production
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of gold produced in thousands of troy ounces.

kpis.name: All-in sustaining cost per ounce
kpis.explanation: Total cost to produce one ounce of gold, including operating, capital, and reclamation expenditures.

kpis.name: Proven and probable reserves
kpis.explanation: Estimated quantity of gold that is economically recoverable with a high degree of confidence.

kpis.name: Annual exploration expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested each year in the exploration of new gold deposits.

kpis.name: Silver production
kpis.explanation: Silver production as a by-product of gold mining.

kpis.name: Zinc production
kpis.explanation: Zinc production from the group's polymetallic mines.

kpis.name: Copper production
kpis.explanation: Copper production from combined mining operations.

kpis.name: Total capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investments made in mine development, equipment, and infrastructure.

kpis.name: Detour Lake expansion
kpis.description: The Detour Lake site continues its ramp-up with targeted production of 650 koz/year, becoming a strategic pillar for future growth.

kpis.name: Canadian Malartic project (Odyssey)
kpis.description: The Odyssey project aims to extend the mine's life and achieve a target production of 750 koz/year, reinforcing North American leadership.

kpis.name: Fosterville restart
kpis.description: Following a restructuring period, Fosterville has regained profitability through a high-grade strategy, contributing significantly to profit margins.

kpis.name: Greenhouse gas emissions reduction
kpis.description: Concrete commitment to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 25% by 2030 compared to 2020 levels, supported by electrification projects.

kpis.name: Acquisition of O3 Mining
kpis.description: The strategic acquisition of O3 Mining strengthens the exploration portfolio and opens new avenues for organic growth.

risks.description: Seismic risks in deep mines such as LaRonde and Goldex can lead to production disruptions and additional costs.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language on risk management, stable trend, high weight due to potential impact on production.

risks.description: The company's profitability is highly dependent on the price of gold, which is subject to significant volatility linked to macroeconomic and monetary conditions.
risks.score_rationale: Frequently mentioned in reports, moderate language intensity, stable risk trend, significant but partially hedged impact.

risks.description: Regulatory changes related to the environment, particularly on carbon emissions and tailings management, could increase operating costs.
risks.score_rationale: High position in risk disclosures, concerned language, upward trend, significant weight due to ESG goals and future permitting.
